steps.name: Start backend and run integration smoke test
steps.run:
# Logged to a file, not inherited stdout: the failure branch needs the
# startup trace, and reading it must not depend on waiting for exit.
python -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8765 >/tmp/backend.log 2>&1 &
SERVER_PID=$!
trap 'kill $SERVER_PID 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT
# CI telemetry from run 41787238076 showed repeated /health 200
# responses taking ~9 seconds. A 5-second client cutoff incorrectly
# treated healthy responses as unready. Allow up to 20 seconds per
# request while bounding total startup readiness to 180 seconds.
start=$SECONDS
ready=0
while (( SECONDS - start < 180 )); do
  if curl -fsS --max-time 20 "http://127.0.0.1:8765/health" >/dev/null; then
    ready=1
    break
  fi
  # Do not wait out the deadline if uvicorn exited.
  if ! kill -0 "$SERVER_PID" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "Backend process exited during startup after $((SECONDS-start))s"
    tail -n 200 /tmp/backend.log
    exit 1
  fi
  sleep 2
done
if [ "$ready" -ne 1 ]; then
  echo "Backend failed to become ready on port 8765 within 180s (20s request timeout)"
  # Never `wait` here. The server is still running by definition of
  # reaching this branch, so waiting for it blocked forever and turned
  # a legible failure into an unbounded hang.
  cat /tmp/backend.log
  exit 1
fi
export BACKEND_URL="http://127.0.0.1:8765"
chmod +x ../scripts/test-integration.sh
bash ../scripts/test-integration.sh

if not files:
    sys.exit(0)
blocked = [
    (re.compile(r"-----BEGIN (?:RSA |EC |OPENSSH )?PRIVATE KEY-----"), "embedded private key material"),
    (re.compile(r"\bAKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}\b"), "possible AWS access key id"),
    (

    (re.compile(r"\bpg_read_file\s*\(", re.I), "pg_read_file()"),
    (re.compile(r"\\copy\b.*\bprogram\b", re.I), "\\copy PROGRAM"),
    (re.compile(r"\blo_import\s*\(", re.I), "lo_import()"),
    (re.compile(r"postgresql://[^\s'\"]+:[^\s'\"]+@", re.I), "postgres URL with embedded password"),

    r"\b(drop\s+(?:table|schema|column)|truncate|delete\s+from|alter\s+table[\s\S]{0,120}drop\s+column|revoke|create\s+policy|drop\s+policy)\b",
    re.I,

        continue
    text = f.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

    manifest['counts']={field:int(suite.attrib.get(field,0))
                        for field in ('tests','failures','errors','skipped')}
    manifest['passed']=manifest['counts']['tests']>0 and not (
        manifest['counts']['failures'] or manifest['counts']['errors']
        or manifest['counts']['skipped'])
else:

    manifest['error']='No JUnit evidence'
cases=[]

    cases.append(json.loads(audit.read_text()))
manifest['independent_receiver_audit']=cases
expected_cases={'sigkill_before_effect','sigkill_after_effect','lost_submit_ack'}

manifest['zero_unauthorized_or_duplicate_writes']=manifest['audit_complete'] and all(

steps.name: Wait for GitHub-connected Railway auto-deploy
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
SHA="$(git rev-parse --short=8 HEAD)"
FULL="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
SVC="gravitre-saas-backend"
ENV_NAME="production"
FORCE="${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.force_railway_up || 'false' }}"
# Push-triggered backend changes: allow GraphQL force if GitHub auto-deploy lags.
if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" = "push" ]; then
  FORCE="true"
fi

match_health() {
  local url="$1" timeout="$2"
  python3 scripts/railway_prod_deploy.py \
    --wait-health-only \
    --timeout-s "$timeout" \
    --health-url "$url" \
    --commit-sha "$SHA"
}

tip_matches() {
  local current="$1"
  [[ "$current" == "$FULL"* ]] || [[ "$current" == "$SHA"* ]]
}

# Never leave a fake tip: /health prefers RAILWAY_GIT_COMMIT_SHA then GIT_SHA.
# A stale GIT_SHA env var can report a tip that is not actually running.
echo "Clearing override GIT_SHA (if set) so health reflects the real commit..."
railway variables delete GIT_SHA --service "$SVC" --environment "$ENV_NAME" || true

CURRENT="$(curl -fsS https://api.gravitre.app/health | python3 -c 'import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get("git_sha",""))' || true)"
echo "current_health_sha=$CURRENT expect=$FULL force=$FORCE"

if tip_matches "$CURRENT"; then
  echo "Prod already on tip — nothing to deploy."
  exit 0
fi

# Always prefer GitHub-connected auto-deploy first. CLI `railway up`
# racing that path fails at Dockerfile COPY with
# "failed to calculate checksum" while the GitHub deploy often succeeds
# (see docs/delivery/railway-github-actions-deploy-status.md).
echo "Waiting for GitHub-connected Railway auto-deploy..."
set +e
match_health "https://gravitre-saas-backend-production.up.railway.app/health" 600
RAIL_WAIT=$?
set -e
CURRENT="$(curl -fsS https://api.gravitre.app/health | python3 -c 'import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get("git_sha",""))' || true)"
if tip_matches "$CURRENT"; then
  match_health "https://api.gravitre.app/health" 180
  echo "GitHub auto-deploy reached tip — no GraphQL force deploy needed."
  exit 0
fi

if [ "$FORCE" != "true" ]; then
  echo "::error::Prod still on $CURRENT after GitHub auto-deploy wait (expect $SHA). Re-run with force_railway_up=true (GraphQL redeploy, not CLI upload)."
  exit 1
fi

# Force path: GraphQL / CLI redeploy of the GitHub commit — never set GIT_SHA
# (that previously faked /health tip without loading the new image).
echo "::warning::force deploy — tip still stale ($CURRENT) — GraphQL redeploy (no CLI upload, no GIT_SHA override)"
set +e
python3 scripts/railway_prod_deploy.py \
  --commit-sha "$FULL" \
  --wait-health \
  --timeout-s 900 \
  --health-url "https://gravitre-saas-backend-production.up.railway.app/health"
DEPLOY_EXIT=$?
set -e
echo "railway_graphql_deploy_exit=$DEPLOY_EXIT railway_wait_exit=$RAIL_WAIT"
if [ "$DEPLOY_EXIT" -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "::warning::GraphQL deploy helper exited $DEPLOY_EXIT — waiting on /health tip anyway"
fi

match_health "https://gravitre-saas-backend-production.up.railway.app/health" 900
match_health "https://api.gravitre.app/health" 180

steps.name: Wait for prod deploy (Research Manager sha)
steps.run:
python3 - <<'PY'
import json, subprocess, sys, time, urllib.request
base = __import__('os').environ['BACKEND_URL'].rstrip('/')
minimum = __import__('os').environ['MIN_SHA'].strip().lower()
for attempt in range(36):
    with urllib.request.urlopen(f"{base}/health", timeout=30) as resp:
        health = json.loads(resp.read().decode())
    sha = str(health.get('git_sha') or '').lower()
    ok = sha.startswith(minimum)
    if not ok:
        try:
            subprocess.run(['git', 'merge-base', '--is-ancestor', minimum, sha], check=True, capture_output=True)
            ok = True
        except subprocess.CalledProcessError:
            ok = False
    print(f"attempt={attempt+1} git_sha={sha} need>={minimum} ok={ok}")
    if ok:
        sys.exit(0)
    time.sleep(20)
print('Timed out waiting for prod deploy')
sys.exit(1)
PY
